metadata.title: Tech is a bright spot, that's helping support the broader market - MarketWatch

content.text:
8 min ago
Tech is a bright spot, that's helping support the broader market
Technology stocks, led by optical and chip companies, are providing support to the broad market indexes, which are trading mixed despite downbeat market breadth.
Only two of the S&P 500's sectors are gaining, but the S&P 500 is inching slightly higher, as shares of optical companies Coherent and Lumentum rank first and third among the index's gainers. Also high on the list of gainers are the stocks of chip companies Broadcom and Lam Research.
The Roundhill Photonics & Optics ETF was surging 3.6% and the PHLX Semiconductor Index was climbing 1.3%.
